name: Assertible

evidence.uptime: C02: scheduled HTTP monitoring from hosted runners, with assertions (U01, U02)

line: Runs scheduled HTTP tests and checks responses against assertions.

free.text: Free for 2 services and 2 standard monitors

uptime.math: One Standard account. Its published service and test limits fit 5 endpoints at $25 a month.
One Standard account. 25 tests fit one service at $25 a month. The full status-page cost isn't known.
100 services go over the 50-service Business limit. How they'd be grouped, and the full cost of this setup, aren't known.
